pricingFaq.question: Can I change plans later?
pricingFaq.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades apply at the start of your next billing cycle.

pricingFaq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
pricingFaq.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans. Enterprise customers can pay via invoice.

pricingFaq.question: Is there a free trial?
pricingFaq.answer: Yes! All paid plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start. Test our WhatsApp notification API and see how it works for your business.

pricingFaq.question: What's your refund policy?
pricingFaq.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. If you're not satisfied for any reason, contact our support team within 30 days of purchase for a full refund.
